name: Kingsley Pines Camp
description_short: Traditional overnight camp in the Sebago Lakes Region of Maine. Sessions run one, two, three or five weeks, and there is a 1-week Explorer program for rising 3rd to 5th graders.
refund_policy_summary: If you cancel before April 1, 2027, you get a full refund minus a $500 cancellation fee per child. No refunds after April 1, 2027. A $1,000 deposit is required to enroll. Installment plans are available. Siblings get 5% off for each additional child.
